meta.title: Minimal ballot
meta.task: Validate the smallest legal ballot shape

questions.question: Where should the rendered ballot HTML be written?

options.label: System temp directory
options.tradeoff: Auto-cleaned by the OS, but the board vanishes between sessions.

options.label: Inside the repo under a scratch directory
options.tradeoff: Survives restarts, but risks committing scratch HTML.

defaults.assumption: Serve the board on the first free port at or above 8700.
defaults.rationale: Avoids collisions with dev servers already bound to 3000 and 5173.
